name: Brother Penance
place: whips himself along the pilgrim road to the abbey and insists everyone else join in
_doc: Stream E (M2). A pilgrim who took it too far. He lashes in a cone, his Penitent Chant must be interrupted or every player is cursed, and at half health he marks a player with a circle of guilt that follows them — then a second, then a third.

party.solo: Solo: an interrupt skill makes it easy; without one, the curse stacks up.
party.m5: M5 adds health per extra player and one more copy of the spread/scatter shapes for parties of 4-5; mechanics stay the same.

pull: "Have you suffered today? No? Let me help."
Brother Penance raises his scourge and smiles kindly.
say.death: "At last... enough." Brother Penance lies down in the road.
say.reset: Brother Penance limps on toward the abbey.

chant.name: Penitent Chant
chant.say: Brother Penance begins to chant — interrupt him!

onInterrupt.say: He loses his place in the verse.

guilt.name: Circle of Guilt
guilt.say: "Who among you is guilty?" — the marked must stand apart!
